scenes.title: Letters and Syllables
scenes.summary: The parts of diction; the letter, as vowel, semivowel or mute, and the syllable.

scenes.title: Connective and Joint
scenes.summary: Sounds without meaning that bind or articulate a statement.

scenes.title: Noun, Verb, Inflection
scenes.summary: The noun without time, the verb with time, and the inflections of case, number and mode.

scenes.title: The Statement
scenes.summary: A statement may lack verbs, like the definition of man; it is one by signifying one thing or by being bound together, like the Iliad.
